ci_support_linux_64_python3.11.____cpyth:
DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: zope.container
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "7.3"
  test_modules:
    - zope.container.tests.test_btree
    - zope.container.tests.test_compile_flags
    - zope.container.tests.test_constraints
    - zope.container.tests.test_contained
    - zope.container.tests.test_contained_zodb
    - zope.container.tests.test_containertraversable
    - zope.container.tests.test_containertraverser
    - zope.container.tests.test_dependencies
    - zope.container.tests.test_directory
    - zope.container.tests.test_find
    - zope.container.tests.test_folder
    - zope.container.tests.test_icontainer
    - zope.container.tests.test_ordered
    - zope.container.tests.test_size

package:
  name: zope.container
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/z/zope.container/zope_container-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b0f91a93507e2f97ef73b8d78bf97849663e355781c7e424e03ad4b9c5afa0e1

build:
  number: 0
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
  host:
    - python
    - pip
    - setuptools
    - persistent
    - zope.proxy
  run:
    - python
    - btrees
    - persistent
    - zope.cachedescriptors
    - zope.component
    - zope.deferredimport
    - zope.dottedname
    - zope.event
    - zope.filerepresentation
    - zope.i18nmessageid
    - zope.interface
    - zope.lifecycleevent
    - zope.location
    - zope.proxy
    - zope.publisher
    - zope.schema
    - zope.security
    - zope.size
    - zope.traversing

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - zope.container
        - zope.container._zope_container_contained
        - zope.container.btree
        - zope.container.contained
        - zope.container.folder
      pip_check: true
  - script:
      - python -m unittest -v ${{ test_modules | join(" ") }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - zodb
        - zope.configuration
        - zope.testing

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/zopefoundation/zope.container
  repository: https://github.com/zopefoundation/zope.container
  documentation: https://zopecontainer.readthedocs.io
  summary: Zope Container
  license: ZPL-2.1
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - COPYRIGHT.txt

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - killua156
